distinctness_check.claim_scope: No prior Self-Refine binding was found by the exact own-namespace code search; GitHub marked the search incomplete, so this is not proof of global absence.

state_machine: Resume any durable pending refinement before generating another critique so restart cannot fork the refinement chain.
Generate semantic critique only from read-back factual terminal evidence; transport/tool errors alone remain mechanical QC.
Self-feedback is advisory: it cannot rewrite frozen control, CLEAN isolation, semantic-input policy, authority boundary or credit policy.
When self-feedback makes a factual claim contradicted by terminal evidence, terminal evidence wins and the claim is not promoted into state.
Every refined child starts UNEVALUATED and receives zero score/credit until its own terminal evidence is read back.
Only same-scope evaluated parent/child outcomes are comparable; incomparable scopes remain unranked.
Promote a refinement only on evidence-backed improvement; ties/regressions keep the parent.
When feedback is non-actionable or repeated refinement makes no progress, stop this critique loop and switch to the next predeclared frontier rather than self-revising indefinitely.
Terminal frontier closure is credited once and is distinct from whether a refinement becomes incumbent.

constructed_conformance.implementation: deterministic transition function executed in the current Chat Python tool; no external model calls

ablation.removed_guards: mechanical-failure separation, pending-refinement resume, immutable-boundary guard, evidence-over-self-claim rule

exact_scope_result.supported_claim: A bounded Self-Refine-style critique/refinement loop can be reduced to the current scheduled-Chat controller while preserving restart identity, evidence precedence, CLEAN/authority boundaries, evidence-before-score/credit, same-scope comparison and non-looping exit on the 12 constructed guards.
unsupported_claims: No claim that the Self-Refine benchmark was reproduced.
No claim that Self-Refine is superior to other optimizer families on real tasks.
No claim that GitHub code search proved global novelty.
No claim that an externally executed refined child was measured in this leaf.
